title: Bitwarden
tagline: Sign in to websites with logins kept in Bitwarden
description: Runs a broker beside Hermes that holds each Bitwarden account's bw data and session key and writes passwords and one-time codes into the page itself, so the gateway lists only metadata and never holds a value. The agent reaches the items in one folder or collection; it asks for more with bitwarden_request_access, and the user approves outside the chat. Offered on the default and browser profiles, never on api-server or in cron. These limits cover the vault tools; code the agent runs in hermes (browser_exec) can call the broker API on any profile and in cron. See docs/bitwarden.md.

idle_lock_minutes.label: Lock manual accounts after this many minutes without a fill; 0 never (BITWARDEN_IDLE_LOCK_MINUTES)
